senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. דוב, זוב)to melt, pine away, languish.—

units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 79a:1">B. Bath. 79ᵃ</cite> (play on <cite ref="M01092"><he>מידבא</he></cite>, <cite ref="Numbers 21:30">Num. XXI, 30</cite>) <he>עד שתַּדְאִיב נשמתן</he> (Var. <he>תדיב</he>, <he>תדוב</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 2) until it (the fire of Gehenna) shall melt their soul.

<cite ref="Nedarim 22a:10">Ned. 22ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 28:65">Deut. XXVIII, 65</cite>) <he>שמכלה … ומַדְאִיב וכ׳</he> which ruins the eyesight and makes life languid. Ch. <cite ref="D00017"><he>דְּאֵיב</he></cite>.
